product_sku: R1-SHOPBOX (the FC workbook's 01_Retail Shopping Basket block; the large size is canonical, the extra-large 510×340×H240 is for reference)
placement_pose_id: psl.e1.shopping_basket_fc.pose@Slot_Cart_R1_Top ((2.600, 0.250, 0.600), Slot_Floor_Cart_R1): seated on the cart cradle. It is a module and a slot apart from the cart, so the basket alone can be replaced
interior_collision_proxy_id: psl.e1.shopping_basket_fc.proxy@REF: canonical smooth proxy. The visual shell (vertical slot grid, label plate, grip) has no collision (6 _visonly); inside, only 13 smooth convex pieces collide (5 plates and 8 rounded corner prisms; _colproxy, purpose=guide). The four wall plates lean at the 11.07° draft of the taper, but each piece is convex
rim_geometry_id: psl.e1.shopping_basket_fc.rim@REF: stacking flange (outside 450 × 330 at the top, 360 × 240 at the bottom; walls a uniform t3.0, so the rim opening is 444 × 324; usable H 227; inner volume 25.8 L)
task_physics_id: static / convexHull / μs 0.6, μd 0.5, e 0 / 13 collision pieces (13 of them proxy only)
color_sku: Light grey (reference). Eight colours are the variant axis: black, charcoal grey, light grey, silver grey, dark green, green (lime), red, yellow
wall_perforation_style: Standard grid perforation (visual only; it does not act as an inner notch)
handle_style: Straight fixed grip at the top (visual only)
rib_corner_style: Five rows of vertical slots and a label plate, vertical corner radius R30 (outer wall visual only, outside the inner envelope; light grey PP, our own retexture)
geometry_validation: REVIEW: the three outside dimensions reproduce fixed values, and a gate compares them to ±5 mm. The workbook leaves the three inner envelope dimensions (top opening, bottom footprint, usable H) open, so they are derived values, waiting for a caliper measurement of the purchased part. opening_plane_z is not final and follows the cart's upper tier plane
source_image_ref: The FC workbook's 01_Retail Shopping Basket block reference table, with the embedded size chart and colour line-up images (received 2026-08-27); our own parametric authoring. The colour line-up image shows a product family with a bail handle, unlike the size chart's fixed grip; the size chart is followed
compatibility_check: PASS: it seats on the upper tier plane (z 600 mm) of the cart that carries it (Slot_Floor_Cart_R1), and mounted_basket_opening_z = 600 + 230 = 830 mm matches this basket's opening_plane_z. A drop probe gate shows by playback that it seats in the cradle
